source_caption:
The famous rotating hallway fight in Inception wasn’t CGI. Director Christopher Nolan built a massive rotating corridor set so Joseph Gordon-Levitt could perform the fight while the entire hallway physically spun around him.

Inception (2010), directed by Christopher Nolan, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page. A mind-bending sci-fi thriller that dives into layered dreams and shifting realities, blending blockbuster spectacle with a puzzle-box story about memory, guilt, and the power of ideas.

#Inception #ChristopherNolan #MindBending #SciFiClassic #ModernClassic

source_details.title: Inception
source_details.synopsis: Inception is a 2010 science fiction heist film written and directed by Christopher Nolan, who also produced it with his wife Emma Thomas. The film stars Leonardo DiCaprio as a professional thief who steals information by infiltrating his targets' subconscious. He is offered a chance to have his criminal history erased as payment for implanting an idea into a target's subconscious. The ensemble cast includes Ken Watanabe, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Marion Cotillard, Elliot Page, Tom Hardy, Cillian Murphy, Tom Berenger, Dileep Rao, and Michael Caine.
